# Refactor
## When to use
Structural improvement only.
## Required context
Callers and current behavior.
## Preconditions
Keep behavior changes separate.
## Procedure
Pin behavior with characterization tests, change one boundary at a time,
and activate `refactoring` for detailed safeguards.
## Tools
Focused checks and diff.
## Rules
Preserve public contracts.
## Verification
Check callers and observable effects.
## Evidence
Characterization results.
## Completion criteria
Structure changed without observed drift.
## Failure modes
Behavior differs: investigate before proceeding.
## References
[Refactor guidance](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. `<plugin root>` is the installed Paved plugin directory, two directories above this SKILL.md. Always run the launcher from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
